svg.title: Dão study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Dão; 2: Viseu; 3: Santar; 4: Prime; 5: Ferrocinto; 6: Moimenta de Maceira Dão; 7: Póvoa; 8: Folhadal; 9: Covilhã; 10: Castelo Branco; 11: Guarda

g.title: 6 · Moimenta de Maceira Dão: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
